facts.fact: Niger's Interior Ministry launched mass biometric enrolment on 15 September 2026 for the AES e-passport range, which includes a travel document for refugees, with enrolment devices to be installed in every region.

systems.platform: biometric enrolment kits, online pre-enrolment via Amana, Nita and Airtel Money
systems.owner: Ministère de l'Intérieur / Direction de la Surveillance du Territoire
